subject: LedgerWorks renewal — attestation, log retention options & evidence transfer
messages:
From: Patricia Gomez <patricia@ledgerworks.com>
To: nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@ledgerworks.com
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood renewal — SOC 2 retention & capacity questions

Hi Nikhil,

Thanks for the renewal packet. A couple of questions from LedgerWorks' side as we prepare for our procurement committee next Thursday:

- Our auditors are requiring a 24-month retention window for certain audit logs (API request logs + access logs) for FY2027 coverage. Is a 24-month retention option available? If so, what is the monthly uplift and any one-time transfer cost for existing historical logs?
- For the attestation, we need a formal evidence handoff plan: what format will you provide logs in, and can Redwood support a bulk export to our S3 (encrypted with our KMS)?
- If we need temporary burst capacity during the evidence upload phase, what are the options? We may need a 2–4 week window of elevated throughput.

Attached: SOC2_questionnaire.pdf (filled initial responses).

Can you get us a short proposal this week? Our procurement lead (procurement@ledgerworks.com) will need a consolidated cost estimate and a short MAP for legal.

Best,

Patricia Gomez
Head of Procurement | LedgerWorks
patricia@ledgerworks.com

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai>
To: Patricia Gomez <patricia@ledgerworks.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 13:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood renewal — SOC 2 retention & capacity questions

Patricia —

Thanks — appreciate the early heads-up. High level answers below and a proposed path forward. See the draft MAP attached (draft_MAP_LedgerWorks_2026-08-12.docx).

1) Retention windows:
   - Standard hosted retention: 365 days (no config change).
   - Extended retention: 730 days (24 months) available as an add-on. Pricing is consumption + storage uplift. We typically model this as a 20–35% uplift on your token/storage baseline depending on log volume.

2) Historical data transfer:
   - We support bulk export to customer S3 with SSE-KMS. One-time transfer fees depend on export volume and whether Dedicated burst capacity is used. Typical one-time transfer estimates for customers your size range from $4k–$18k.

3) Burst capacity for evidence upload:
   - Option A: Temporary Hosted burst (up to 4x throughput for 2–4 weeks) — meter at higher rate.
   - Option B: Short-term Dedicated pool (reserved for the upload window) with an onboarding credit applied.

Next steps I propose:
- Kimberly (security) and Laura (renewals) will map required log types and provide an evidence index template.
- I will produce 3 pricing scenarios (365d default; 730d with hosted uplift; 730d with 1-month Dedicated burst + onboarding credit).
- Deliver MAP and cost estimate by Fri 2026-08-14 so you can review prior to procurement.

Attached: draft_MAP_LedgerWorks_2026-08-12.docx

Would you like us to include Brightline (your auditor) in a short technical sync as well?

Thanks,
Nikhil Sharma
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 10:45:00 -07:00

Hi Patricia — looping in a few technical details so your auditors have clarity.

On Wed, 12 Aug 2026 at 9:12 AM Patricia Gomez <patricia@ledgerworks.com> wrote:
> Our auditors are requiring a 24-month retention window for certain audit logs (API request logs + access logs)...

Quick technical mapping:
- Log categories we can provide for the attestation:
  * API request logs (per-request metadata, timestamps, request id)
  * Admin access logs (console actions, iam changes)
  * System audit logs (service restarts, infra-level events)
  * KV/epoch snapshots for model serving (where required for traceability)

- Export formats: gzipped JSONL or CSV for tabular fields. We recommend JSONL for fidelity.
- Transfer options: direct S3 PUT using a pre-provisioned IAM role OR Redwood-initiated multipart upload to a customer S3 with SSE-KMS. Both support your KMS key.
- Hashing: We can produce SHA256 digests for each file and an overall manifest.

Retention mechanics and costs:
- 365d baseline: included.
- 730d: storage uplift + small per-month indexing surcharge. We will provide a volume-based estimate once we have a sample 30-day export.

Attachment: log_mapping_v2.csv (field-level mapping & estimates).

Proposed evidence sync: 30–45 minute call with LedgerWorks + Brightline to confirm auditors' exact field requirements. Available slots: Thu 2026-08-13 15:30 PT or Fri 2026-08-14 09:30 PT. Pick one and we’ll lock it.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Security | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

We also have a contract committee meeting on 2026-08-20; if you can provide a consolidated price + MAP by 2026-08-19 EOD PST it would greatly help our cadence.

Summary / proposed ask to procurement:
- Scenario 1: 365d retention (no change) — baseline renewal pricing.
- Scenario 2: 730d retention (hosted uplift) — estimated +28% uplift on storage & indexing. Request: give LedgerWorks a 20% discount on uplift line (net ~ +22% vs baseline).
- Scenario 3: 730d retention + 2-week Dedicated burst for upload (onboarding credit applied) — list uplift ~ +34%, offer a one-time $10k onboarding credit to cover part of transfer work, and provide a tiered discount to achieve an effective 25% uplift.

Operational commitments for all scenarios:
- Evidence staging window: 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-21 (3-week preferred window).
- Delivery artifacts: gzipped JSONL files, SHA256 manifest, and an evidence index (we will share template).
- KMS integration: Redwood supports SSE-KMS with customer key; LA will validate in technical sync.

Attachments to include in reply: pricing_scenarios_LW.xlsx, evidence_index_template.csv

If that commercial posture is OK I will send the consolidated MAP + pricing to Patricia by EOD 2026-08-19. Marissa — can we approve the $10k one-time credit and the proposed discount band so I can close the procurement thread?
